title.zh: 普遍规范根据的持续方向

scope.zh: 保留7日首要方向；8日明确公理路线修正对其特定任务优先适用。
scope.en: Retain the 7 October priority; the 8 October explicit-axiom correction takes precedence for its specified task.

objective.zh: 推进整体生成与实际实现如何具有伦理意义，并形成实际理由和约束。
objective.en: Investigate how whole generativity and actual realization carry ethical significance and support practical reasons and constraints.

premises.zh: 区分根据、认识、动机与实际遵循；生生的正面范围不先改成已独立判好之物。
premises.en: Distinguish warrant, recognition, motivation and actual compliance; do not redefine living as only what has already been independently valued.

completion.zh: 不得以给定目标的保存替代伦理根据；先信用已完成的 G0/J 推论，再指出新增连接。
completion.en: Preserving a supplied objective does not replace ethical warrant; credit completed G0/J inferences and specify the new connection.
